scope: Corollary 3.7 (Finite arrays and higher kernels) of the manuscript “Entropy equality and local symmetry in negative curvature” (preprints/Entropy-equality-and-local-symmetry-in-negative-curvature-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 339 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8658ab8209a8aa0c), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 13-14. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: In either normalized tower, the independent coordinates introduced at level j have weights at least jχ∗ for a fixed χ∗ > 0. A prescribed upper weight bound consequently uses only finitely many independent tower coordinates and finitely many monomials. On the array of monomials of a fixed weight d, normal substitution has the single exponent −d, and inverse substitution has exponent d, with two-sided estimates 13 and arbitrarily small exponential slack. These estimates continue to hold for finite tensor arrays and their invariant subquotients, with the corresponding sums and differences of weights.
